title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds 64,132 after a 1.6 percent gain, with fear still dominant at 41 on the index. Miners show conviction as hashrate prints 1000 EH/s. The mempool sits heavy at 78,437 transactions yet fees remain cheap at 3 sat per vbyte, pointing to steady but not urgent demand. Block 962,970 just cleared. US session action stayed range-bound with no decisive breakout. Overnight focus stays on volume recovery and any fresh macro prints that could shift sentiment before the next resistance test.
